cards.title: Reading: True, False or Not Given?
cards.meta: Exam-style practice: a 700-word academic passage with 13 questions (True/False/Not Given, matching information, summary completion), then drills on checking statements word by word and spotting paraphrase.

cards.title: Reading: Matching Headings
cards.meta: Match headings to paragraphs by finding each paragraph's main idea — and learn to ignore the trap headings that only repeat its words.

cards.title: Reading: Sentence and Summary Completion
cards.meta: Exam-style practice: a 790-word academic passage with 13 sentence and summary completion questions, then drills on predicting the word type and keeping to the word limit.

cards.title: Writing Task 1: Describing Trends
cards.meta: Describe a line graph accurately — trend verbs and adverbs, “rose sharply” vs “a sharp rise”, prepositions with numbers — then write your own 150-word report.

cards.title: Writing Task 1: Bar Charts and Tables
cards.meta: Compare figures instead of listing them — “twice as many”, “just under a third”, “whereas” — write a clear overview, then describe a table in at least 150 words.

cards.title: Writing Task 1: Describing a Process
cards.meta: Describe a process diagram stage by stage — the passive (“the glass is crushed”), sequencing words such as “once” and “at the next stage”, and an overview — then describe a process yourself.

cards.title: Writing Task 2: The Opinion Essay
cards.meta: “To what extent do you agree?” — keep a clear position, choose linkers by their job, write strong topic sentences, then write your own 250-word essay.

cards.title: Writing Task 2: The Discussion Essay
cards.meta: “Discuss both views and give your own opinion” — report each side fairly (supporters argue, critics point out), keep your own view clear and write a conclusion that answers the question.

cards.title: Writing Task 2: The Problem–Solution Essay
cards.meta: “What are the causes … and what measures could be taken?” — explain causes with leads to, is caused by and due to, then match each solution to the cause it fixes.
